themes_detail.label: For-Hire Vehicle Surge
themes_detail.summary: For-hire vehicle complaints spiked to 5 this week, a 233% increase versus the 1.5 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks, signaling a sudden surge in Uber/Lyft-related disruptions (double parking, congestion, noise) in Mott Haven/Melrose.
evidence: 5 for-hire vehicle complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.5 weekly average (233% spike, z-score 3.5)
Sustained pattern consistent with gig economy congestion problems in dense neighborhoods
No corresponding Reddit or community board discussion yet—story ahead of public awareness
reporting_angles: Interview residents on specific blocks experiencing surge; map hotspots of complaints
Reach out to TLC or Uber/Lyft for statement on driver concentration or surge pricing events in the district

themes_detail.label: Missed Garbage Collections
themes_detail.summary: Missed sanitation collection complaints jumped to 11 last week, a 238% spike versus the 3.2 weekly average, suggesting a breakdown in DSNY service reliability that is hitting residents mid-week.
evidence: 11 missed collection complaints last week vs. 3.2 weekly average (238% increase, z-score 2.84)
Aligns with long-running sanitation staffing/resource questions in the district
No Reddit discussion or community board alert yet—emerging story
reporting_angles: File FOIL request for DSNY route changes, sick leave, or staffing reductions in CD 201 last 2 weeks
Canvas affected blocks to document impact; interview sanitation workers about conditions

themes_detail.label: Cannabis Retailer Complaints
themes_detail.summary: Cannabis retailer complaints surged 700% two weeks ago (8 complaints vs. 1.0 weekly average), suggesting rapid unlicensed dispensary expansion or legitimate retail opening with neighborhood friction in Mott Haven/Melrose.
evidence: 8 cannabis retailer complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 1.0 weekly average (700% spike, z-score 5.72)
Likely connected to 350 Grand Concourse FRESH proposal (licensed retail in public review stage)
No Reddit or community board documentation of organized complaint campaign yet
reporting_angles: Investigate whether spike is unlicensed operators or backlash to 350 Grand Concourse FRESH application; interview complainants on specific location and nature of complaints
Cross-reference 311 complaint addresses with known retail applications or enforcement actions

themes_detail.label: Vehicle Noise Acceleration
themes_detail.summary: Vehicle noise complaints peaked at 26 three weeks ago, a 145% increase versus the 10.6 weekly average, reflecting what may be persistent street racing, modified exhaust activity, or temporary event-related congestion in the district.
evidence: 26 vehicle noise complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 10.6 weekly average (145% spike, z-score 5.13)
Converges with broader noise complaint pattern (2005 residential noise complaints over 90 days)
No recent Reddit or news coverage to explain spike; suggests underreported street issue
reporting_angles: Interview residents and NYPD about street racing, motorcycle groups, or construction activity 3 weeks ago; map complaint addresses
Request NYPD complaint and enforcement data for noise-related stops in the district during that week

themes_detail.label: Safety Complaint Spike
themes_detail.summary: Safety complaints spiked 158% two weeks ago (10 complaints vs. 3.9 weekly average), though the nature of complaints (assault, robbery, suspicious activity) is unclear from 311 data and warrants investigation.
evidence: 10 safety complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 3.9 weekly average (158% spike, z-score 4.49)
No corresponding increase in NYPD crime stats, Reddit discussion, or community board alert—signal may be 311 reporting artifact or early warning
Lack of external corroboration makes this harder to verify but worth urgent follow-up
reporting_angles: FOIL NYPD crime data for the district during the spike period; cross-reference 311 safety complaint addresses with felony reports
Contact local precinct for context; interview community leaders about any known incidents or organizing
